description: ABTW Symbol Map — complete catalogue of all symbols in the Academy system
golden_rule: Symbols never fully explain themselves. They respond to perception.

symbols.name: The Delayed Shadow
symbols.meaning: Time is not fixed. Perception creates delay.
symbols.notebook_entry:
PATTERN: SHADOW DELAY
Observed: movement mismatch (×3)
Delay: ~0.4s
Location: East Corridor
symbols.lumi_note: It's repeating. The interval is consistent.
symbols.nela_note: Don't write it yet. Something else is coming.
symbols.echo_note: This is not the original pattern. A trace of something recorded too early.

symbols.name: The Incomplete Circle
symbols.meaning: Understanding is never complete. The gap is intentional.
symbols.visual: Circle drawn on wall — always missing one segment
symbols.notebook_entry:
SYMBOL: INCOMPLETE CIRCLE
Location: Observatory
Status: Forming
Note: The missing segment changes position each visit.
symbols.lumi_note: The gap rotates by 15 degrees each observation.
symbols.nela_note: It's waiting for the right moment to close.
symbols.echo_note: The circle fragment. It never completed.

symbols.name: The Reflected Word
symbols.meaning: Knowledge reflects differently depending on who reads it.
symbols.visual: Text in reflection shows different words than original
symbols.notebook_entry:
PATTERN: REFLECTED WORD
Observed: text mismatch in mirror surface
Original: unknown
Reflection: unknown
Note: Changes with each reading.
symbols.lumi_note: The reflection shows a different language. Or the same language, differently arranged.
symbols.nela_note: Read it when you're not trying to.
symbols.echo_note: The word that was almost understood.

symbols.name: The Convergence Point
symbols.meaning: All paths in the Academy lead to the same understanding.
symbols.visual: Invisible point where all corridor sight lines intersect
symbols.notebook_entry:
SYMBOL: CONVERGENCE POINT
Location: Junction
Status: Hidden
Note: Only visible when all three are present.
symbols.lumi_note: Geometrically, this point shouldn't exist in this architecture.
symbols.nela_note: Stand here. All three of us. Now.
symbols.echo_note: The point that was almost reached.

symbols.name: The Memory Trace
symbols.meaning: Past events leave visible marks on the present.
symbols.visual: Faint outline of a figure that no longer stands there
symbols.notebook_entry:
PATTERN: MEMORY TRACE
Observed: residual figure outline
Location: Dormitory Hall
Note: Appears only at night.
symbols.lumi_note: The outline matches no current student's proportions.
symbols.nela_note: Someone stood here for a very long time.

symbols.name: The Garden Spiral
symbols.meaning: Nature in the Academy grows according to perception, not physics.
symbols.visual: Plant growth follows a spiral that mirrors the symbol system
symbols.notebook_entry:
SYMBOL: GARDEN SPIRAL
Location: Main Garden
Status: Forming
Note: The spiral expands by one rotation each season.
symbols.lumi_note: The growth rate is mathematically precise. Not natural.

symbols.name: The Observatory Star Map
symbols.meaning: The Academy's position in the world is not fixed.
symbols.visual: Star map on ceiling that doesn't match any known constellation
symbols.notebook_entry:
SYMBOL: STAR MAP
Location: Observatory Ceiling
Status: Hidden
Note: Stars shift position when observed directly.
symbols.lumi_note: These stars don't exist in any astronomical catalogue.
symbols.echo_note: The map that was almost read.

symbols.name: The Echo Corridor
symbols.meaning: Sound in the Academy carries memory.
symbols.visual: Footsteps echo with a slight delay and different rhythm
symbols.notebook_entry:
PATTERN: ECHO CORRIDOR
Observed: sound delay ~0.3s
Rhythm mismatch detected
Location: West Corridor
symbols.lumi_note: The echo rhythm matches a walking pattern from approximately 3 hours ago.

Layer2_Symbol.description: Forming patterns. Require Clarity to understand.

Layer3_Hidden.description: Deep system symbols. Require full Trio synchronization.

symbol_evolution_rules: Recording too early creates Echo — incomplete fragment
Waiting allows deeper layers to emerge
Symbols in the same room can form constellations
Each book introduces new symbol categories
Resolved symbols leave permanent marks in the notebook
